incidents.title: Payment authorization timeouts after connection pool change
incidents.root_cause: DB connection pool max_connections reduced from 200 to 50 in a config change; payments-api exhausted pool under normal load.

incidents.title: Marketing site 500s after CDN config typo
incidents.root_cause: Misconfigured cache-control header caused origin overload.

incidents.title: Auth token TTL reduced; cascading re-auth storm
incidents.root_cause: JWT TTL reduced from 60min to 5min in auth-service without consumer notification. Downstream services hit token endpoint at 40x normal rate.

incidents.title: Batch job OOM after query change
incidents.root_cause: Reporting query stopped using indexed column; full scan caused OOM.

incidents.title: PII written to debug logs
incidents.root_cause: A debug log statement added in PR #8821 logged the full request body, including cardholder email and last-4. Detected by log scanner 6 hours after deploy.

incidents.title: Hardcoded API key rotated by vendor mid-day
incidents.root_cause: Payments-api had a hardcoded vendor API key in source. Vendor rotated the key on their side; payments-api began returning 502s. Key should have been in secrets manager.

incidents.title: Checkout button regression
incidents.root_cause: CSS change hid the submit button on Safari iOS.
